scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn caragent_api.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd services/worker && uv run celery -A caragent_worker.app worker --loglevel=INFO
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @caragent/web lint && pnpm --filter @caragent/contracts lint && cd services/api && uv run ruff check . && cd ../worker && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @caragent/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @caragent/contracts typecheck && cd services/api && uv run mypy src && cd ../worker && uv run mypy src
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @caragent/web test && pnpm --filter @caragent/contracts test && cd services/api && uv run pytest -q && cd ../worker && uv run pytest -q
scripts.smoke:local: pnpm --filter @caragent/web smoke && pnpm --filter @caragent/contracts smoke && cd services/api && uv run python -m caragent_api.scripts.smoke_local && cd ../worker && uv run python -m caragent_worker.scripts.smoke_local
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm smoke:local
